obituaries.full_text:
Lawrence William Carney Jr., 62, of Chester, an American Indian of the Nanticoke-Lenni-Lenape 
  Tribe and a longtime West Chester church employee, died Nov. 23 at Taylor Hospital 
  after a brief illness.
